message: Updater/version pin repair plus Pick My Drive phone-row cleanup. v8.0.92 now registers its own version-pinned worker correctly, so the installed version no longer falls back to v8.0.90 or repeatedly offers v8.0.91 after restart. On phones, each Pick My Drive round keeps number + track + delete on the first line and gives Layout a true full-width second line. Car History career/BACK, Rally/Hot Wheels LOCATION clues, Evil bridge and Results/Corrections remain unchanged. Morris variant labelling remains deferred.
